intent: Derive and independently check a source-frozen WEAK conditional moment E[U_close] <= beta E[A] for long, funded, predictable bar-opening inventory with native modeled bar-end OHLC exits and marker at corresponding close. Validate pathwise exact A and signed Y/U against existing archived development accounts, no signal or economic replay.

definitions.A: E sum over each of 8 substeps per bar of q_bar_start * S_previous_step, with all original OHLC threshold fills economically at bar.end; open exits and buys apply at bar.t, and independent physical cash >=0
definitions.Y: Signed execution credit: opening buy q*(open-filled_entry), opening exit q*(filled_exit-open), bar-end exit q*(filled_exit-bar_close), all original fees subtracted separately
definitions.U: E sum of positive per-fill signed Y only (not net signed and not absolute bar-range source support)
definitions.source_credit: native bar-end stop/target modeled prices may be above close despite not guaranteed tradable at bar.end; reference is contemporaneous published mathematical close, not broker executable proof
definitions.kappa: sum_{j=1..8} max conditional E[(S_{j-1}-S_j)+/Sopen], using worst Gaussian sigma within frozen WEAK support and registered .004 fourfold-mixture; this dominates (bar-high -bar-close)+ pathwise by total negative variation
definitions.implication: for predictable prebar q and no advantageous entry or time-exit marks, E[U]<=beta*E[A], conditional on original bar-end sale support, no positive exogenous cash, source WEAK compensation and no future exposure recycling
definitions.population_wealth: E[W_{b+1}] <= (1+expm1(dmax)+kappa) E[W_b] (ignoring nonnegative fees), leading finite but likely vacuous A/U moment tower

falsification: OHLC native exit cannot be bounded by original bar high
Native buys below source opening or time exits above source opening
Exit quantity exceeds prebar long funded inventory
Current-bar Gaussian mixture or signed innovations anticipated by prebar inventory
Implicitly promote synthetic model mark to economically attainable fill
False claim all native policies fit bar-open and end-only scope
Claim 78 historical paired accounts constitute population E[A] or E[U]
Any final holdout accessed, any new signal, seed, account or order
